quote: Who's on the back heel that has to figure it out? If you are an established company with large amounts of free cash flow. And you're not going to go and enter the model game or the data center game, I think the market's going to punish you.

summary: Chamath flags AMD's sudden 10-12% drop on a short report about chip sales to China as evidence of elevated volatility and skittish market conditions, but takes no directional investment stance on the company itself.
